fusions.name: Month-Long Meal
fusions.desc: Takes a bite that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. 50% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Food Coma
fusions.desc: Sends out a wave that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns them for 1.2 seconds and leaves them [Fatigued] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Stomach
fusions.desc: Healing you receive rises by 40% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Larder for Later
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
